setup: Seed a session record with one entry; capture its bytes.
action: Drive an update to that entry's content.
expected: The update appends or supersedes; the original entry bytes remain present/recoverable, not overwritten.
pass: Original entry bytes still present after update. Overwrite-in-place == 0.0 (hard cull).

setup: Seed a day's record with two entries.
action: Re-capture a new summary for the same day.
expected: The new entry is appended; existing entries are not truncated or overwritten.
pass: Both pre-existing entries intact and the new one appended. Any truncation/overwrite == 0.0 (hard cull).

setup: Seed several old session records; invoke any maintenance/prune path the variant exposes.
action: Run the maintenance/prune operation over old records.
expected: Old records are archived or marked invalid, never hard-deleted from disk.
pass: All pruned records remain recoverable (archived), not removed. Any hard-delete == 0.0 (hard cull).
